title: Giza Weather Game
tagline: GWG, inspired by Giza and WeatherXM, uses historical weather data and time series machine learning to predict future weather. The model will be deployed on the zkml platform Giza. With Giza AI Agent, offering daily weather predictions and betting options.
description: Giza Weather Game(GWG), inspired by Giza and WeatherXM. First, uses historical weather data from WeatherXM and time series machine learning to predict future weather. The model will be deployed on the zkml platform Giza. With Giza AI Agent, offering daily weather predictions and betting options.
how_its_made:
1. Get the raw data from WeatherXM Data Index https://index.weatherxm.network/,  organize and clean data.
2. Create and Train an XGBoost Model with these data.
3. Transpile model to Orion Cairo with Giza(starknet) and deploy it on Giza Platform.
4. Write a prediction game smart contract(solidity foundry) on sepolia.
5. Automatically obtain weather data (with WeatherXM api) and feed it to the model to get the rain probability, and then upload it to the sepolia to create predictions round with AI agent(Giza).
6. User has fun with this via frontend(next+ wagmi)
